exposure: Administration of adenoviruses expressing green fluorescent protein (GFP, control)
cohort: Pregnant CD-1 mice (n=20 total, 11 in hsFlt-1-e15a group, 9 in GFP control group) were studied from mid-gestation.
finding: Overexpression of hsFlt-1-e15a in pregnant mice induced elevated mean arterial blood pressure, focal glomerular changes, higher urine albumin/creatinine ratios, and reduced microvessel outgrowth, effectively modeling late-onset preeclampsia-like symptoms.
birth_weight: Fetal weights were measured and did not differ between the hsFlt-1-e15a and control groups.
gest_age: The study involved mice from gestational day 6 to day 18.
